sources.snippet: OTel-2.-LLM-31B-IT by farbodtavakkoli — 32.11B parameter apache-2.0 model with 262K context. Minimum 21GB VRAM (Q4_K_M quantization). Compatible with 46 GPUs, cloud rental from $0.03/hr. 3 quantization options available.
